title: Elephants and Farmers
topic: ข่าว/สิ่งแวดล้อม
lines: In parts of eastern Thailand, wild elephants often leave the forest at
night and eat crops in nearby farms. For farmers, **this** can mean losing
a whole year of income in one night. Some farmers have tried loud noises
and fires to scare the elephants away, but the animals soon learn that
Now one village is testing a surprising idea: bees. Farmers hang beehives
on wires around their fields. When an elephant touches a wire, the hives
shake and the angry bees come out. Elephants are afraid of bee stings near
their eyes and trunks, so **they** turn back. In the first year, elephants
entered the fields eighty percent less often. There is another benefit:
the farmers can sell the honey. "We used to see elephants as enemies,"
says one farmer, Mr. Somsak. "Now we have found a way to live with **them**.
Nobody gets hurt, and **we** even earn a little extra money."
